title: I Saw A MISSING Poster With My Own Face #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you walk to school on a normal morning.
There's a MISSING poster on the lamppost.
You call Mum, laughing. "Someone's pranking me!"
Mum is crying. "Who is this? Our child has been missing all night."
A police car slows down beside you.
The officer looks at the poster, then at you.
*"Kid, the one we found this morning looks exactly like you."
Mum looks up from the poster. She looks at me for a long time.
Then she asks, "So which one of you came home last night?"
